newsitem.title: INDIA: Landslides kills at least 28 in India - news agency.
newsitem.headline: Landslides kills at least 28 in India - news agency.

text.p: At least 28 people were killed in landslides triggered by heavy rains in northeastern India, United News of India (UNI) said on Monday.
The news agency said at least 30 people were injured overnight in the landslides in the capital of Sikkim state, Gangtok.
UNI quoted a senior police official, P.C. Sharma, as saying a four-storey building and two government bungalows collapsed in Gangtok, crushing eight people.
Sharma told the news agency that 24 bodies had been recovered.
